open: This is Rotterdam Approach. Real airspace, real procedures, live weather. And for the next shift, it's all yours.
briefing: Pick your airport and how busy you want it. Turn on events if you like surprises.
contact: Every pilot has a voice, and an accent. Drag to vector them. Near a waypoint, it snaps to a direct. Stack your instructions, and send them in one call.
taxi: Departures start at real gates, and taxi the actual taxiways out to the runway.
lifeliner: And then there's Lifeliner Two, Rotterdam's trauma helicopter. Clear it to lift, keep the traffic out of its way, and it's on scene in minutes.
vfr: Light aircraft join the circuit. You fit them in between the jets.
events: Windshear. Go-arounds. A closed runway. Some shifts fight back.
summary: At the end of it, you get a grade. And a reason to go again.
montage: London City. Washington National. San Diego. Six airports in all.
end: Rotterdam Approach. The frequency is yours.
